_readme: AI-assisted candidate-specific review corrections prepared from the extracted resume text and supplied candidate data. The applicant must compare every note with the original resume and personally sign off before submission. reviewed:true records that this preliminary evidence review and override have been applied by the project workflow; it is not a claim that the applicant has independently verified the facts. Supported fields: note, reviewed, text (full replacement text), lcaYears, designYears, totalYears, lcaProjects, designProjects, classification (LCA | UX | BOTH | NEITHER). Blank source file anonymized_resume_1793685080327.docx is intentionally not overridden; it must remain excluded until the actual resume or verified text is obtained.
